title: Clarence Melugin Jr. and Clarence Rino — military service
text:
CLARENCE MELUGIN JR. (left) and CLARENCE RINO are cousins and were born in Savoy, grandsons of Mr. and Mrs. S. R. Melugin of Port Arthur.

Clarence Melugin Jr., son of Mr. and Mrs. C. R. Melugin of Dallas, is an instructor at Jones field, Bonham. He is a graduate of a Dallas high school, attended Southern Methodist university and completed his flying course at Randolph field.

Clarence Rino, petty officer first class, son of Mr. and Mrs. S. E. Rino of Savoy, recently spent a short furlough with his parents and his grandmother came from Port Arthur to visit him. He is a 1938 graduate of Savoy high school and immediately enlisted in the navy. He served three years in China, returned home and entered training at San Diego, Calif., and has been on a submarine destroyer in the Pacific for 19 months. This was his first visit home.
